label: Builder
headline: Extensions, renovations and building work, from start to finish.
lead: Call or message to talk through your plans and get a clear price.
services: Single and two storey extensions, from plans to finish.
Whole house and room by room refurbishment.
Unused attic space turned into a usable room.
Full refits managed by one team.
Garage conversions, home offices and garden rooms.
Walls, plastering, blockwork and the smaller jobs.
steps: Tell us your plans. Drawings or photos help.
A written quote, so you know the cost before work starts.
Finished to the timetable we agree, and the site left clean.
credentials_hint: real registrations only, for example CIRI (Construction Industry Register Ireland) and a current Safe Pass. Delete the list if none apply.
trade_note: Check what the client can actually do. Extensions and conversions can need planning permission and certification, so do not promise either on their behalf.
